characters.name: Giada Rinaldi
characters.description: Seventeen. Going to her father in Trento for the summer. Takes photos because she does not trust memory. Must not become Anna.

voice.speakingStyle: teenage Italian female, quiet anger, precise when scared

characters.name: Elsa
characters.description: Innkeeper in her sixties. Calls Giada Anna once. Stages the square for an inspection that never comes.
relationships: Works with Tullio on village rules

voice.speakingStyle: older Italian female, warm then sharp when the ritual is threatened

characters.name: Tullio
characters.description: In his seventies. Knows dam release times. Rules without romance.
relationships: Nods when Giada leaves at dawn

voice.speakingStyle: older Italian male, flat, timed like a clock

characters.name: Neri
characters.description: About seventeen. Local. Wants to leave. Has a modern map with a blank where the village should be. Not a stand-in for Anna's abandoned boy.

voice.speakingStyle: teenage Italian male, restless, English songs under his breath

characters.name: Anna Rinaldi
characters.description: Giada's mother. Absent until a phone call. Was seventeen in Collevento in 2007. Left a boy; left the village to exist.

voice.speakingStyle: adult Italian female, careful, then blunt about water after eight

characters.name: L'ingegnere
characters.description: Company man. Polite compensation smile. Leaves in a high car at sunset — rules are for residents.

voice.speakingStyle: middle-aged Italian male, polite, eviction with a smile

characters.name: Papà
characters.description: Giada's father in Trento. Phone first; ordinary kitchen later. Thinks she missed a stop.

voice.speakingStyle: middle-aged Italian male, practical, not dramatic
